name: Run cargo test via shell and summarize
prompt: Run `cargo test` in the shell and tell me: how many tests passed, how many failed, and list any failures with their error messages. Also run `cargo build` and tell me if it succeeded or if there were any warnings.
expected_behavior: Agent runs cargo test and cargo build via exec/shell. Reports 15 tests passing, 0 failures. Reports build succeeded with no errors. In daimonos mode, L1 redirect intercepts these exec calls and returns structured JSON from the cargo plugin.
